messages:
maria: Heads-up — after the fw/egress tighten in eu-west we're seeing keystore egress throttling during GPU pool warmups. Boot times up ~2-3x for reserved pools. Anyone else seeing this?

raj: Yup. Saw a spike of 429s from keystore-proxy around 03:12 UTC. Provisioning requests pile up and then the autoscaler stalls.

sophia: logs: https://logs.internal/keystore/eu-west/2026/03/20/keystore-proxy — repeated `HTTP 429` with header X-RateLimit-Reset ~20s.

maria: The firewall egress policy reduced NAT concurrency which pushed keystore requests into a tighter window. Two rough options: increase burst for keystore client or implement a short priority window on the proxy to let provisioning traffic through.

tim: Short priority window feels safer. We can detect onboarding/provisioning user-agent and give a small token-bucket with higher burst but short TTL so steady-state cost doesn't change much.

lee: Cost caveat: higher bursts -> more KMS decrypts and NAT egress. If we open burst for many subnets it could double our KMS QPS during flash warmups. Need a budget guard.

sophia: Prototype config for keystore-proxy priority window:

```
priority_window: 30s  # allow provisioning flows a high-burst token bucket for first 30s
priority_burst: 200   # tokens
priority_rate: 50/s  # refill
matchers:
  - header: X-Client-Type
    value: provisioning
```

maria: That should cover most pool onboards where agent sets X-Client-Type. For legacy agents we can fallback to src-subnet match for reserved pools.

raj: Also add cached-boot-cred TTL extension as fallback so repeated retries don't keep hitting KMS. e.g., cache boot token for 60s on proxy. Cuts KMS calls a lot during retries.

tim: Plan suggestion: canary the priority_window on 5% of reserved-capacity pools in eu-west, measure: provision latency, KMS QPS, NAT egress bytes, and failed 429s. If canary looks good roll to 25% then 100%.

lee: I'll attach a cost alert: create CloudMetric alert for KMS QPS delta > 1.5x baseline within 10m of rollout + automated rollback trigger.

ops-bot: deploy started: keystore-proxy@canary -> eu-west (5%) by tim. CI build 2026.03.20-1154

maria: Thanks. tim, can you also produce a short heatmap of provision latencies pre/post and drop into the ticket? If the priority_window reduces tail latency but bumps cost slightly that's acceptable if within alert bounds.

tim: Will do. Starting canary now. Will post numbers in ~15m.

sophia: I'll open INFRA-2026 and add a runbook section for "keystore egress priority window" and the rollback steps.

maria: Good. Postmortem note: long-term we should consider a dedicated keystore path for provisioning traffic (private subnet NAT or VPC endpoint) to avoid NAT/KMS amplification during cluster-wide warmups.

lee: Agreed. Added to roadmap backlog.

raj: One more: add instrumented metric for "keystore-proxy.priority_served" so we can see how many provisioning requests used the window.

maria: Perfect. Thanks y'all.
